description: Lesson-entry artifact — STORED per-entry YAML grammar, Decision-0 reversal (PM-ratified 2026-06-30). Each lesson lives in a separate file: state/lessons/<date>-<slug>.yaml, written atomically by coordinator-queue-append --schema lessons (or coordinator-lesson-add), validated by validateFrontmatter() in bin/lib/schema.js via this schema. Spec backlink: docs/plans/2026-06-30-lessons-md-to-queryable-yaml-queue.md § C1. This is the FOURTH queue on the shared base field-set (improvement-queue / bug-backlog / debt-backlog / lessons). Pattern: required base fields + domain required fields + domain optional fields. See docs/wiki/lessons-schema.md for the full field table and lifecycle. Negative-spec: Do NOT add an `id:` field — filename is the canonical identity key (D2 convention). Do NOT add a stored `lifecycle:` or `live:` field — liveness is derived from status. Do NOT write entries to state/lessons.md — that path is superseded.

created.description: Date this lesson entry was authored (YYYY-MM-DD).

title.description: Human-readable one-line title for this lesson.

body.description: Prose body of the lesson — the pattern observed and its implication.

status.description: Lesson lifecycle status. resolved is a back-compat alias for applied — prefer applied for new entries; liveness() maps resolved to DONE (C3b).

scope.description: Scope classification for this lesson — universal applies across all coordinator-pipeline projects, project is scoped to the originating repo, wiki-only is a doc-only fold with no code/behavior change.

from_repo.description: Repository this lesson was captured from.

target_wiki.description: Wiki doc this lesson should fold into, when known at capture time.

proposed_target.description: Proposed doctrine/prompt/hook/wiki target for this lesson's fix, when not yet a confirmed target_wiki.

evidence.description: Evidence supporting this lesson — file:line reference, log excerpt, or observed failure.

closed_at.description: Date this lesson entry was closed (YYYY-MM-DD).

closed_by.description: Session or agent identifier that closed this lesson entry.

tags.description: Free-form tags for categorization and retrieval.

queue_scope.description: Which queue this lesson entry lives in — central (cross-project, claude-klabauter-resident post-migration) or project (per-repo).

trigger.description: What triggered capture of this lesson — the event or observation that prompted it.

why.description: Why this pattern matters — the underlying rationale.

how_to_apply.description: Concrete guidance on how to apply this lesson going forward.

system.description: Provenance metadata for this lesson entry — which session/agent captured it and what it's linked to.

created_by_session.description: Session identifier that created this lesson entry.

created_by_agent.description: Agent identifier that created this lesson entry.

linked_sessions.description: Session identifiers linked to this lesson entry.

linked_commits.description: Commit SHAs linked to this lesson entry.

provenance_completeness.description: Whether the provenance metadata for this entry is complete or unknown.
